description: PSGC (Power System Graph Converter) Code is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Svetlana V. Poroseva, Dominik Neumayr (University of New Mexico). PSGC stands for Power System Graph Converter. PSGC is a graph software designed to facilitate conversion of a network drawing into an adjacency matrix or an adjacency list. Such conversion is useful for many network analyses. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
